subject: ui
title: Sepulcra's shell and accessibility
note: Lane m5-a11y: the title screen, saved settings, rebinding, gamepad pause, subtitles and captions, colour-vision themes and handheld profiles. Shown: the title on a Steam Deck profile (interface x1.15 by default); the accessibility screen on a 175% display, where the two largest interface sizes change nothing and are greyed out; a cutscene line as a subtitle with its speaker; the pause menu in the red-green (deuteranopia) theme after a gamepad's Start. From the live check on the Intel iGPU (37 checks).
